name: IMP-215 - Dispatch Single Meta Conversion - Claim Contract

parameters.query:
with input as (
  select NULLIF('{{ String($json.conversion_outbox_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')::uuid as conversion_outbox_id
), claimed as (
  update public.conversion_outbox as claimed_co
     set status = 'processing',
         attempts = claimed_co.attempts + 1,
         next_attempt_at = now() + interval '30 minutes',
         updated_at = now()
    from input i
   where claimed_co.id = i.conversion_outbox_id
     and '{{ $json.dispatch_mode }}' = 'inline'
     and claimed_co.platform = 'meta'
     and claimed_co.status = 'pending'
     and claimed_co.next_attempt_at <= now()
     and claimed_co.attempts < 4
  returning claimed_co.id, claimed_co.attempts as claimed_attempt
)
select
  co.id as outbox_id,
  co.normalized_event_id,
  co.ghl_location_id,
  co.contact_id,
  co.event_code,
  co.platform,
  co.route,
  co.meta_event_name,
  co.payload as outbox_payload,
  co.status as outbox_status,
  co.attempts,
  coalesce(cl.claimed_attempt, NULLIF('{{ $json.claimed_attempt ?? \"\" }}', '')::integer) as claimed_attempt,
  '{{ $json.dispatch_mode }}' as dispatch_mode,
  NULLIF('{{ String($json.claimed_attempt ?? \"\") }}', '')::integer as claimed_attempt,
  co.created_at as outbox_created_at,

  en.raw_event_id,
  en.received_at,
  en.event_datetime,
  en.client_id,
  en.client_name,
  en.phone,
  en.phone_raw,
  en.email,
  en.first_name,
  en.last_name,
  en.full_name,
  en.lead_entrada,
  en.lead_origem,
  en.ctwa_clid,
  en.fbp,
  en.fbc,
  en.fbclid,
  en.gclid,
  en.gbraid,
  en.wbraid,
  en.valor_ganho,
  en.forma_ganho,
  en.procedimento_ganho,
  en.source_url,
  en.source_id,
  en.payload as normalized_payload,

  nullif(
    coalesce(
      co.payload->'attribution'->>'source_id',
      en.source_id
    ),
    ''
  ) as meta_source_id,

  regexp_replace(coalesce(cb.meta_ad_account_id, ''), '^act_', '') as meta_primary_account_id,
  meta_source_match.matched_account_id as meta_matched_account_id,

  case
    when nullif(
      coalesce(
        co.payload->'attribution'->>'source_id',
        en.source_id
      ),
      ''
    ) is null
      then 'missing_source_id'

    when nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(cb.meta_ad_account_id, ''), '^act_', ''), '') is null
      then 'missing_primary_account'

    when meta_source_match.matched_ad_id is null
      then 'source_not_found'

    when meta_source_match.matched_account_id = regexp_replace(coalesce(cb.meta_ad_account_id, ''), '^act_', '')
      then 'owned_primary_account'

    else 'other_account'
  end as meta_source_ownership_status,

  case
    when meta_source_match.matched_ad_id is not null
      and meta_source_match.matched_account_id = regexp_replace(coalesce(cb.meta_ad_account_id, ''), '^act_', '')
      then true
    else false
  end as meta_source_owned_by_impuls,

  to_jsonb(cb) as client_config

from input i

join public.conversion_outbox co
  on co.id = i.conversion_outbox_id
left join claimed cl on cl.id = co.id

left join public.events_normalized en
  on en.id = co.normalized_event_id

left join public.clients_base cb
  on cb.ghl_location_id = co.ghl_location_id

left join lateral (
  select
    regexp_replace(coalesce(m.account_id, ''), '^act_', '') as matched_account_id,
    m.ad_id as matched_ad_id
  from public.meta_ads_daily m
  where m.client_id = en.client_id
    and m.ad_id = nullif(
      coalesce(
        co.payload->'attribution'->>'source_id',
        en.source_id
      ),
      ''
    )
  order by m.date desc
  limit 1
) meta_source_match on true

where co.platform = 'meta'
  and (
    ('{{ $json.dispatch_mode }}' = 'inline' and cl.id is not null)
    or
    ('{{ $json.dispatch_mode }}' = 'scheduled' and co.status = 'processing'
      and co.attempts = NULLIF('{{ String($json.claimed_attempt ?? "") }}', '')::integer
      and co.next_attempt_at > now())
  )

limit 1;

update public.conversion_outbox
set
  status = case
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'pending'
      and attempts >= 4
      then 'failed'
    else NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')
  end,

  attempts = attempts,

  response = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.meta_response ?? {}).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb,

  last_error = NULLIF('{{ String($json.last_error ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', ''),

  sent_at = case
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'sent'
      then now()
    else sent_at
  end,

  next_attempt_at = case
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') in ('sent', 'skipped')
      then null

    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'failed'
      then null

    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'pending'
      and attempts >= 4
      then null

    -- O anúncio ainda não apareceu em meta_ads_daily.
    -- Não chama a Meta; aguarda os próximos ciclos de sync.
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.last_error ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')
      = 'meta_source_ownership_unverified_source_not_found'
      and attempts = 1
      then now() + interval '6 hours'

    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.last_error ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')
      = 'meta_source_ownership_unverified_source_not_found'
      and attempts = 2
      then now() + interval '12 hours'

    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.last_error ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')
      = 'meta_source_ownership_unverified_source_not_found'
      then now() + interval '24 hours'

    -- Backoff padrão para falhas transitórias da API/transporte.
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'pending'
      and attempts = 1
      then now() + interval '15 minutes'

    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'pending'
      and attempts = 2
      then now() + interval '1 hour'

    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.final_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'pending'
      then now() + interval '6 hours'

    else null
  end

-- zero rows means stale_result: do not apply an old response or retry HTTP.
where id = '{{ $json.outbox_id }}'::uuid
  and status = 'processing'
  and attempts = coalesce(
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.claimed_attempt ?? "") }}', '')::integer,
    attempts
  )

returning
  id,
  normalized_event_id,
  event_code,
  route,
  meta_event_name,
  status,
  attempts,
  last_error,
  sent_at,
  next_attempt_at;

insert into public.workflow_execution_logs (
  workflow_key,
  workflow_name,
  workflow_category,
  n8n_execution_id,
  client_id,
  client_name,
  ghl_location_id,
  status,
  stage,
  metadata,
  stages
)
values (
  '1.2',
  '1.2 - Dispatch Single Meta Conversion',
  'dispatch',
  '{{ $execution.id }}',
  NULLIF('{{ String($json.client_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')::uuid,
  NULLIF('{{ String($json.client_name ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ String($json.ghl_location_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', ''),
  'running',
  'outbox_fetched',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({
    outbox_id: $json.outbox_id ?? null,
    normalized_event_id: $json.normalized_event_id ?? null,
    raw_event_id: $json.raw_event_id ?? null,
    event_code: $json.event_code ?? null,
    platform: "meta",
    route: $json.route ?? null,
    meta_source_id: $json.meta_source_id ?? null,
    meta_source_ownership_status: $json.meta_source_ownership_status ?? null,
    meta_primary_account_id: $json.meta_primary_account_id ?? null,
    meta_matched_account_id: $json.meta_matched_account_id ?? null
  }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify({
    input: {
      status: "ok",
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    },
    outbox: {
      status: "fetched",
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb
)
returning id as workflow_log_id;

update public.workflow_execution_logs
set
  status = 'success',
  stage = case
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'sent'
      then 'dispatch_sent'
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'skipped'
      then 'dispatch_skipped'
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'failed'
      then 'dispatch_failed_recorded'
    when NULLIF('{{ String($json.status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'pending'
      then 'dispatch_retry_scheduled'
    else 'dispatch_result_recorded'
  end,
  finished_at = now(),
  duration_ms = (extract(epoch from (now() - started_at)) * 1000)::bigint,
  items_processed = 1,
  items_failed = 0,
  error_message = null,
  error_node = null,
  metadata = coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ||
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
      outbox_status: $json.status ?? null,
      platform_result_reason: $json.last_error ?? null,
      attempts: $json.attempts ?? null,
      next_attempt_at: $json.next_attempt_at ?? null
    }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb,
  stages = coalesce(stages, '{}'::jsonb) ||
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
      result: {
        status: $json.status ?? null,
        reason: $json.last_error ?? null,
        attempts: $json.attempts ?? null,
        at: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb
where id = NULLIF(
  '{{ String($('Log Abertura 1.2').first().json.workflow_log_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  ''
)::uuid
  and status = 'running'
returning
  id,
  workflow_key,
  workflow_name,
  status,
  stage,
  started_at,
  finished_at,
  duration_ms,
  metadata,
  stages;

parameters.content:
## Observabilidade V2 — 1.2 Meta

A abertura e o fechamento do log agora fazem parte do caminho principal.

**Correção crítica**
O node de abertura não roda mais em paralelo com o processamento. No modo de execução v1, o ramo principal podia chegar ao fechamento antes de o log ser criado; depois o ramo paralelo criava uma linha `running` que nunca era encerrada.

**Novo ciclo**
Get Single Meta Outbox
→ Log Abertura 1.2
→ Build Meta Request
→ envio/skip
→ Update Single Meta Outbox Result
→ Log Fechamento 1.2

**Semântica**
- `workflow_execution_logs.status = success` quando o dispatcher conclui e registra o resultado.
- `conversion_outbox.status` continua indicando `sent`, `skipped`, `failed` ou `pending`.
- Rejeição da Meta registrada na outbox não é tratada como erro técnico do n8n.
- Erros técnicos inesperados continuam sendo capturados pelo workflow 9.9.


### Match Quality V2.1
- O dispatcher não refaz a decisão de origem Meta; confia no outbox criado pelo 1.1.
- `client_ip_address` e `client_user_agent` são enviados quando o Router os capturou do `contact.attributionSource`.
- Lead web em rota `standard` usa `action_source = website`.
- Agendado/Ganho CRM continuam `action_source = system_generated`.
- `fbp` enriquece matching, mas não determina roteamento.


### Owned Traffic Guard V2.2
Para a rota `whatsapp_bm`, o dispatcher cruza o `source_id` do evento com
`meta_ads_daily` e compara o `account_id` encontrado com
`clients_base.meta_ad_account_id` (conta primária da Impuls).

Política:
- `owned_primary_account` → envia para a Meta;
- `other_account` → `skipped: meta_source_not_owned_by_impuls`;
- `missing_source_id` → skipped por propriedade não verificável;
- `source_not_found` → skipped por propriedade não verificável;
- `missing_primary_account` → failed por configuração incompleta.

A regra afeta apenas `whatsapp_bm`. Eventos `standard` de website permanecem inalterados.


### Safe Retry V2.3

A resolução de propriedade da rota `whatsapp_bm` agora distingue:

- `owned_primary_account`: envia normalmente;
- `other_account`: `skipped` definitivo, pois pertence a outra conta/agência;
- `missing_source_id`: `skipped`, pois não há evidência suficiente;
- `source_not_found`: permanece `pending`, sem chamada à Meta, aguardando
  o anúncio aparecer em `meta_ads_daily`;
- `missing_primary_account`: `failed`, pois falta configuração obrigatória.

Backoff específico de `source_not_found`:
1ª tentativa → +6 horas
2ª tentativa → +12 horas
3ª tentativa → +24 horas
4ª tentativa sem resolução → `failed`

O fallback por Graph API não foi colocado no caminho normal. A estrutura deixa
o motivo identificado em `last_error` e `meta_response.retry_class`, permitindo
adicionar esse fallback futuramente apenas para exceções.


### Standard Route Scope Fix V2.4

Correção de bug técnico no `Build Meta Request`:

`buildStandardEvent()` usava `leadEntradaBucket` sem declará-lo no próprio
escopo. A variável existia apenas dentro de `buildOne()`, portanto rotas
`standard` podiam lançar `ReferenceError: leadEntradaBucket is not defined`
logo após `outbox_fetched`.

Correção:
- `buildStandardEvent()` resolve `leadEntradaBucket` via
  `extractLeadEntradaBucket(row)`;
- o workflow volta a seguir para envio/resultado/update da outbox;
- o Error Workflow 9.9 foi explicitamente associado ao workflow para capturar
  futuros erros técnicos inesperados.


## IMP-215 claim contract
- `inline` preserves the existing 1.1 path and request builders/retries.
- `scheduled` accepts only `processing` plus the exact claimed attempt and lease.
- stale or terminal rows return zero rows and never reach HTTP.
- scheduled close does not increment attempts a second time.
